normalizationRules: Keep a separate persistent model only when identity, lifecycle, permissions, querying, retention or concurrency require it.
Derived totals/statuses, filters, UI state and projections are not canonical tables.
Shared jobs, delivery attempts, integrations and audit infrastructure are reused across domains.

consolidations.reason: One table with purpose, expiry and one-time consumption semantics avoids duplicate token infrastructure.
Security login outcome is an immutable audit event subtype, not a separate product aggregate.
The UI only reads derived plan capabilities; persist overrides only inside subscription/config until independent lifecycle is proven.
Generation progress is a typed durable job; a second job table is unnecessary.
Calendar credentials/cursor use the common integration connection lifecycle.
Settings are an immutable version snapshot without independent identity/lifecycle.

consolidations.replacement: Risk with contract_id and source clause
consolidations.reason: Contract risks use the same risk workflow and should not fork the state machine.
Palette entries have no independent permissions/lifecycle and are versioned with the concept.
Wedding-day recording is another access path to the canonical finance aggregate.
Closure tasks reuse task assignment, deadline, completion and audit behavior.
Refund is a finance direction/type, not a separate lifecycle table.
Same audience snapshot, delivery attempts, retry and reporting behavior as campaigns.
All exports use the common durable job and file result contract.
Channel/provider attempt semantics are shared with campaign delivery.

consolidations.replacement: Activity read model projected from DomainEvent and redacted AuditEvent
consolidations.reason: Activity is explicitly a projection and must not become a second source of truth.
